project_scope.note: Current Kew treatment accepts bushy bluestem and broomsedge in Anatherum. A. virginicum remains a range HOLD in this project.

priority: wet-site vs old-field context as secondary support
study_strategy.warning: The familiar Andropogon names are still common in Texas. Search aliases before assuming a record is a separate taxon.

quick_split: Anatherum glomeratum — dense brushlike fluffy crown; many clustered inflorescence units.
Anatherum virginicum — narrower silky racemes, individually more sheath-enclosed; persistent broomlike winter clump.
comparison_lesson.caveat: A. virginicum is researched but not installed as a native canonical species until three exact target-zone counties are locked.
